TMF-Seg · MICCAI 2026

Motivation & Proposed Method

Problem
01 Image-only segmentation struggles when lesions are diffuse, low-contrast, or heterogeneous — text descriptions provide complementary regional context.
02 Existing text-guided methods fuse features uniformly — no mechanism to selectively emphasize frequency components relevant to the described finding.
03 Standard CNN/ViT decoders lack the iterative refinement capacity of diffusion models for recovering fine-grained mask structure.
Proposed — TMF-Seg
🔗
Image-Text Conditional Fusion
Cross-attention: image as Q, text (BioBERT) as K and V → z_fused. Image encoder trainable, text encoder frozen.
📊
Text-Guided Multi-Frequency Enhancement
DCT decomposes z_fused into high/mid/low frequencies. Text adaptively weights α_h, α_m, α_l via MLP + Softmax → z_enhanced.
🌀
Latent Diffusion Segmentation
z_enhanced conditions a denoising U-Net ε_θ. Single-step inference: Concat(y_T, z_enhanced) → ŷ_0 → Decoder → mask Ŝ.
